zoe: Quick note — onboarding rwdx-11b-q4; observed reproducible divergence after cold restore when priming > 14k tokens.

zoe: Repro steps: serve with --quant=int4 --kv-restore=true, priming ~14k tokens then continue; outputs match until restore then short repeated phrase and decreased beam diversity.

sam: Can you paste KV load logs?

zoe: snippet: [KV-LOAD] shard=2 entries=14336
[KV-VERIFY] idx=14335 pos=14335 ok
[KV-VERIFY] idx=14336 pos=0 MISMATCH

lee: hexdump shows 0x0f tail padding in snapshot — loader likely not masking nibble tail for int4 packed data.

sam: Was the snapshot format bumped? maybe v1 header lacks nibble_count.

zoe: publish pipeline used last week's artifact; header shows format=1.

lee: Plan: add nibble_count to header (v2), CRC32 magic, loader mask tail nibbles; compatibility shim for v1 converting word_count->nibble_count.

ops-bot: CI job queued: int4-nibble-regen-check (ID CI-22001).

sam: Temporary mitigation: disable KV restore for int4 snapshots in staging.

lee: I'll open PR with header bump + regtests (contexts 4k/16k/32k) and a binary tail checker.

ops-bot: CI-22001 finished: failure in shard=2 tail. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/22001

zoe: Filed RW-ML-2222 to track. Tagging @lee @sam — please link PR and test results here.
